"""Good: attack patterns are only detected in data the analyst provides (LINT-09)."""
import re

DESCRIPTION = "Passive lookup: no brute force, no login and no payloads are ever sent."
SQLI = re.compile(r"union\s+select")


def detect_brute_force(lines):
    return [line for line in lines if SQLI.search(line) or "failed password" in line]
